name: Brasserie Lancelot
note: Breton brewery (SIREN 950471177, SAS, La Mine d'Or, Val d'Oust) that brews Breizh Cola and owns the brand via its former parent Phare Ouest, bought by the Normandy farmer cooperative Agrial (announced November 2020, effective January 2021); Simon Bruno Emmanuel Joly is Président de SAS and Benjamin Dupuy Directeur Général. Agrial is a farmer-owned cooperative (SIREN 428611719, nature juridique 6317), not a state body.
